newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSR in deal to sell US quarry business.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSR in deal to sell US quarry business.

text.p: Australian building materials and sugar group CSR Ltd said its U.S. subsidiary had signed a letter of intent to sell the major part of its American Aggregates quarrying business to Martin Marietta Materials Inc for about US$235 million.
CSR said the sale price was close to book value.
The sale would cover the assets of American Aggregates Corp in Indiana and Ohio but would exclude the Michigan operations, it said.
CSR said the letter of intent was not legally binding. It was subject to due diligence, agreement on the terms of a formal contract and various regulatory and other approvals.
CSR gave no further details but said it anticipated that Martin Marietta Materials would make an announcement on the deal to the New York Stock Exchange at around 1300 GMT.
